senses.sense_definition: A large, strong, and healthy person.

examples.text: The young <w>strapper</w> easily lifted the heavy wooden crate onto the truck.
He grew into a tall <w>strapper</w> who excelled at rugby.

senses.sense_definition: A person employed to groom and care for racehorses.

examples.text: The <w>strapper</w> spent the morning brushing the racehorse before the big event.
Every professional <w>strapper</w> knows how to keep the horses calm before a race.

senses.sense_definition: A person who works with straps or leather goods.

examples.text: The leather <w>strapper</w> carefully cut the hide to make new belts.
A skilled <w>strapper</w> can repair almost any damaged leather bag.

senses.sense_definition: A wire connecting two switches to control one light from different locations.

examples.text: The electrician installed a <w>strapper</w> to allow two-way light control.
Check the <w>strapper</w> if the hallway light does not turn on from both ends.

senses.sense_definition: A cow that produces only a small amount of milk.

examples.text: The farmer decided to sell the <w>strapper</w> because it was no longer productive.
Feeding a <w>strapper</w> is not cost-effective for a dairy farm.
